name: io.github.Sarg338/steam-mcp
description: Read-only Steam: games, reviews, current builds/depots, prices, players, libraries, friends, achievements, and recommendations.
title: Steam (read-only)

environmentVariables.name: STEAM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Steam Web API key (optional, free at https://steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey). 22 tools work without it — store, reviews, prices, current players, current AppInfo/builds/depots, deals, Steam Deck, and achievement rarity. A key adds 19 account-only tools plus personalization: library, playtime, friends, achievements, wishlist, inventory, and taste matching.

environmentVariables.name: STEAM_USER
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Your own Steam vanity name, SteamID64, or profile URL, so the account tools default to you when you omit a steamid. Public profile name, not a secret.
